info.name: Protec UAT2 - Add-on Quotes (PCAR, P2W, PCV, GCV)
info.description: One quote per add-on for each product on protecuat2. Each request is a quotation calculate on a base quote built from an issued policy of the same product, with one add-on added. Calculate accepts the input body directly, so no persist step is needed. Set accessToken. Add-ons that need a sum insured or input value may return no premium change; PAOCC currently fails in rating.

item.name: PCAR add-on quotes
item.description: Base PCAR quote plus each add-on; persist then calculate. Run in order.

exec: pm.test('HTTP 200',()=>pm.response.to.have.status(200));const r=pm.response.json();pm.test('Premium is non-zero',()=>pm.expect(Number(r.DuePremium)).to.be.above(0));

exec: pm.test('HTTP 200',()=>pm.response.to.have.status(200));const r=pm.response.json();const code='IMT32';function find(n){if(n&&typeof n==='object'){if(n.ProductElementCode===code&&!Array.isArray(n))return n;for(const k of Object.keys(n)){const x=find(n[k]);if(x)return x;}}return null;}const e=find(r);pm.test('Quote total premium is non-zero',()=>pm.expect(Number(r.DuePremium)).to.be.above(0));pm.test('Add-on '+code+' is in the quote',()=>pm.expect(e).to.not.be.null);pm.test('Add-on '+code+' is priced',()=>pm.expect(e&&Number(e.DuePremium)>0).to.be.true);

exec: pm.test('HTTP 200',()=>pm.response.to.have.status(200));const r=pm.response.json();const code='IMT1TP';function find(n){if(n&&typeof n==='object'){if(n.ProductElementCode===code&&!Array.isArray(n))return n;for(const k of Object.keys(n)){const x=find(n[k]);if(x)return x;}}return null;}const e=find(r);pm.test('Quote total premium is non-zero',()=>pm.expect(Number(r.DuePremium)).to.be.above(0));pm.test('Add-on '+code+' is in the quote',()=>pm.expect(e).to.not.be.null);pm.test('Add-on '+code+' is priced',()=>pm.expect(e&&Number(e.DuePremium)>0).to.be.true);

exec: pm.test('HTTP 200',()=>pm.response.to.have.status(200));const r=pm.response.json();const code='IMT15';function find(n){if(n&&typeof n==='object'){if(n.ProductElementCode===code&&!Array.isArray(n))return n;for(const k of Object.keys(n)){const x=find(n[k]);if(x)return x;}}return null;}const e=find(r);pm.test('Quote total premium is non-zero',()=>pm.expect(Number(r.DuePremium)).to.be.above(0));pm.test('Add-on '+code+' is in the quote',()=>pm.expect(e).to.not.be.null);pm.test('Add-on '+code+' is priced',()=>pm.expect(e&&Number(e.DuePremium)>0).to.be.true);

Memo: mandatory/optional = Optional; dependency = none; has SI = Yes; SI option = Input; default SI = n/a. Remarks: Moved to TP from PA; CSI rate: Rs.7 per Rs.10,000 CSI (or part thereof); Max Rs.2,00,000 per person. UAT2 result: premium 1226

exec: pm.test('HTTP 200',()=>pm.response.to.have.status(200));const r=pm.response.json();const code='IMT16';function find(n){if(n&&typeof n==='object'){if(n.ProductElementCode===code&&!Array.isArray(n))return n;for(const k of Object.keys(n)){const x=find(n[k]);if(x)return x;}}return null;}const e=find(r);pm.test('Quote total premium is non-zero',()=>pm.expect(Number(r.DuePremium)).to.be.above(0));pm.test('Add-on '+code+' is in the quote',()=>pm.expect(e).to.not.be.null);pm.test('Add-on '+code+' is priced',()=>pm.expect(e&&Number(e.DuePremium)>0).to.be.true);

request.description: Comment: IMT.18. PERSONAL ACCIDENT TO UNNAMED HIRER AND UNNAMED PILLION PASSENGERS (Motorised Two Wheelers with or without side car only) (IMT18). Memo: mandatory/optional = Optional; dependency = none; has SI = Yes; SI option = Input; default SI = n/a. Remarks: Number of pillion passengers to capture. CSI rate: Rs.7 per Rs.10,000 CSI (or part thereof); Max Rs.2,00,000 per person. UAT2 result: premium 1226

exec: pm.test('HTTP 200',()=>pm.response.to.have.status(200));const r=pm.response.json();const code='IMT25TP';function find(n){if(n&&typeof n==='object'){if(n.ProductElementCode===code&&!Array.isArray(n))return n;for(const k of Object.keys(n)){const x=find(n[k]);if(x)return x;}}return null;}const e=find(r);pm.test('Quote total premium is non-zero',()=>pm.expect(Number(r.DuePremium)).to.be.above(0));pm.test('Add-on '+code+' is in the quote',()=>pm.expect(e).to.not.be.null);pm.test('Add-on '+code+' is priced',()=>pm.expect(e&&Number(e.DuePremium)>0).to.be.true);

request.description: Comment: IMT. 29.  LEGAL  LIABILITY  TO EMPLOYEES  OF  THE  INSURED  OTHER THAN  PAID  DRIVER AND/OR CONDUCTOR  AND/OR CLEANER  WHO MAY  BE  TRAVELLING  OR  DRIVING IN THE  EMPLOYER‟S  CAR (IMT29). Memo: mandatory/optional = Conditional mandatory; dependency = none; has SI = No; SI option = NA; default SI = Unlimited(9999999999). Remarks: Rs.25/- per employee; default cover Rs.60 for TW (It is mandatory if CustomerTYpe is Individual). UAT2 result: premium 1226

exec: pm.test('HTTP 200',()=>pm.response.to.have.status(200));const r=pm.response.json();const code='IMT31TP';function find(n){if(n&&typeof n==='object'){if(n.ProductElementCode===code&&!Array.isArray(n))return n;for(const k of Object.keys(n)){const x=find(n[k]);if(x)return x;}}return null;}const e=find(r);pm.test('Quote total premium is non-zero',()=>pm.expect(Number(r.DuePremium)).to.be.above(0));pm.test('Add-on '+code+' is in the quote',()=>pm.expect(e).to.not.be.null);pm.test('Add-on '+code+' is priced',()=>pm.expect(e&&Number(e.DuePremium)>0).to.be.true);

exec: pm.test('HTTP 200',()=>pm.response.to.have.status(200));const r=pm.response.json();const code='LLOCC';function find(n){if(n&&typeof n==='object'){if(n.ProductElementCode===code&&!Array.isArray(n))return n;for(const k of Object.keys(n)){const x=find(n[k]);if(x)return x;}}return null;}const e=find(r);pm.test('Quote total premium is non-zero',()=>pm.expect(Number(r.DuePremium)).to.be.above(0));pm.test('Add-on '+code+' is in the quote',()=>pm.expect(e).to.not.be.null);pm.test('Add-on '+code+' is priced',()=>pm.expect(e&&Number(e.DuePremium)>0).to.be.true);

exec: pm.test('HTTP 200',()=>pm.response.to.have.status(200));const r=pm.response.json();const code='MOTOROD';function find(n){if(n&&typeof n==='object'){if(n.ProductElementCode===code&&!Array.isArray(n))return n;for(const k of Object.keys(n)){const x=find(n[k]);if(x)return x;}}return null;}const e=find(r);pm.test('Quote total premium is non-zero',()=>pm.expect(Number(r.DuePremium)).to.be.above(0));pm.test('Add-on '+code+' is in the quote',()=>pm.expect(e).to.not.be.null);pm.test('Add-on '+code+' is priced',()=>pm.expect(e&&Number(e.DuePremium)>0).to.be.true);

exec: pm.test('HTTP 200',()=>pm.response.to.have.status(200));const r=pm.response.json();const code='ADPACOD';function find(n){if(n&&typeof n==='object'){if(n.ProductElementCode===code&&!Array.isArray(n))return n;for(const k of Object.keys(n)){const x=find(n[k]);if(x)return x;}}return null;}const e=find(r);pm.test('Quote total premium is non-zero',()=>pm.expect(Number(r.DuePremium)).to.be.above(0));pm.test('Add-on '+code+' is in the quote',()=>pm.expect(e).to.not.be.null);pm.test('Add-on '+code+' is priced',()=>pm.expect(e&&Number(e.DuePremium)>0).to.be.true);

request.description: Comment: IMT.45. Indemnity to Hirer - Liability Only Policy - Negligence of Owner or Hirer (IMT45). Memo: mandatory/optional = Optional; dependency = none; has SI = No; SI option = NA; default SI = Unlimited(9999999999). Remarks: Loading 25% / flat premium - key cover for Product Code 1204 (TP-only) Protec confirmed (125 flat premium). UAT2 result: premium 17231

exec: pm.test('HTTP 200',()=>pm.response.to.have.status(200));const r=pm.response.json();const code='TRAILERTP';function find(n){if(n&&typeof n==='object'){if(n.ProductElementCode===code&&!Array.isArray(n))return n;for(const k of Object.keys(n)){const x=find(n[k]);if(x)return x;}}return null;}const e=find(r);pm.test('Quote total premium is non-zero',()=>pm.expect(Number(r.DuePremium)).to.be.above(0));pm.test('Add-on '+code+' is in the quote',()=>pm.expect(e).to.not.be.null);pm.test('Add-on '+code+' is priced',()=>pm.expect(e&&Number(e.DuePremium)>0).to.be.true);
